verdict.rationale: Bento's core product includes flow-based automations triggered by behavior, events, and tags that run without manual intervention ('Build flows from behavior, events, and tags. Check every branch before it runs.'), backed by an events API to track activity and trigger automations, plus webhook actions for external systems. This directly matches autonomous background automation for a marketing/automation platform. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration that flows execute reliably unattended, and more detail on scheduling/trigger conditions beyond marketing copy.
